command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP: capture baseline =="
BASELINE_BOOTID=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
echo "boot_id=$BASELINE_BOOTID"

echo "== STEP: update /etc/default/grub =="
sudo -n cp /etc/default/grub /etc/default/grub.bak
if grep -q '^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=' /etc/default/grub; then
  sudo -n sed -i 's/^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="\(.*\)"$/GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="\1 audit=1"/' /etc/default/grub
fi
grep '^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=' /etc/default/grub

echo "== STEP: grubby persist across all kernels (BLS) =="
sudo -n grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"

echo "== STEP: regen grub.cfg (BIOS) =="
sudo -n grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg

echo "== STEP: verify BLS entries =="
sudo -n grubby --info=ALL | grep -E "^(kernel|args)="

echo "== STEP: verify kernelopts in grubenv =="
sudo -n grep -o 'kernelopts=[^"]*' /boot/grub2/grubenv || true

echo "== STEP: verify default kernel args include audit=1 =="
sudo -n grubby --default-kernel
DEFAULT_KERNEL=$(sudo -n grubby --default-kernel)
sudo -n grubby --info="$DEFAULT_KERNEL" | grep args=
